oi_source: NSE official participant-wise EOD OI CSV archive
oi_scope_warning: NSE participant-wise OI is aggregate Index F&O participant totals, not separate NIFTY/SENSEX/BANKNIFTY participant OI. The same aggregate OI features are tested independently against each index price series.

validation.chronological_split: first 70% train; last 30% holdout, ordered by date
validation.directional_hit_rate: reported for futures net OI and futures long/short changes (short changes sign-inverted); option-side long/short is correlation-only.
validation.reason: Exploratory sample only. No OI weight or trading score is assigned. Require longer history and stable chronological holdout performance across indices before considering any live score contribution.

NIFTY.price_source: Yahoo Finance daily open and close (^NSEI)
NIFTY.target_definition: OI change known after EOD on date t; entry is next trading session open; exit is the close of session 1, 3, or 5 counted from that next session. No same-day close entry.
